definitions.gloss: semi-voiced sound; p-sounds in Japanese kana
definitions.explanation: The set of Japanese syllables beginning with the 'p' sound (ぱ{行|ぎょう}), indicated by a small circle (゜) added to the は{行|ぎょう} kana. The five semi-voiced sounds are: ぱ (pa), ぴ (pi), ぷ (pu), ぺ (pe), ぽ (po).

examples.japanese: 「ぱ」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半濁音|はんだくおん}です。
{半濁音|はんだくおん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半濁点|はんだくてん}（゜）⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: Semi-voiced sounds are indicated by adding a handakuten (゜) mark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半濁音|はんだくおん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「は{行|ぎょう}」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、ぱ・ぴ・ぷ・ぺ・ぽ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: Japanese semi-voiced sounds only exist in the ha-row, consisting of just five: pa, pi, pu, pe, po.

notes:
A Japanese phonetics term composed of ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half/semi), {濁|だく} (voicing), and {音|おん} (sound). The name literally means 'half-voiced sound,' reflecting the historical analysis that p-sounds were considered intermediate between the voiceless h-sounds (⟦{清音|せいおん}→清音：23458_seion⟧) and the voiced b-sounds (⟦{濁音|だくおん}→濁音：19295_dakuon⟧).

THE KANA SYSTEM:
Japanese kana are organized into three phonetic categories:
- ⟦{清音|せいおん}→清音：23458_seion⟧: voiceless/clear sounds — the basic kana (⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, さ, た, ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧, etc.)
- ⟦{濁音|だくおん}→濁音：19295_dakuon⟧: voiced sounds — marked with ⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧ (゛): が, ざ, だ, ば
- {半濁音|はんだくおん}: semi-voiced sounds — marked with {半濁点|はんだくてん} (゜): ぱ, ぴ, ぷ, ぺ, ぽ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半濁音|はんだくおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧: pronunciation of semi-voiced sounds
- {半濁点|はんだくてん}: the circle diacritic mark (゜)
- は{行|ぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半濁音|はんだくおん}: the semi-voiced sounds of the ha-row

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{濁音|だくおん}→濁音：19295_dakuon⟧: voiced sounds — b, d, g, z sounds marked with ⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧ (゛)
- ⟦{清音|せいおん}→清音：23458_seion⟧: voiceless/clear sounds — the basic unmarked kana
- ⟦{撥音|はつおん}→撥音：23467_hatsuon⟧: the nasal sound 'n' (ん)
- ⟦{拗音|ようおん}→拗音：23466_youon⟧: contracted sounds — small や, ゆ, ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ combinations (きゃ, しゅ, ちょ, etc.)
